Vinton Cerf, co-creator of TCP/IP, is retiring from his role as Google's chief internet evangelist, shifting focus to the future of AI agent interoperability.

The Bright Side:
His focus on formal standards for AI agents could prevent the 'telephone game' of ambiguity in future autonomous systems.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
No plane error detected. The narrative aligns the person (WHO) with the technical challenge (WHAT) and the future (WHY).

By advocating for open, standardized protocols, Cerf empowers a decentralized future. This transparency in design avoids the trap of proprietary silos, fostering a collaborative ecosystem.

The Trajectory: The Path of Grace.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Grace. The alignment of past success with future utility is high.

The Unavoidable Truth: Standardization is the bedrock of durable systems.

The Unavoidable Lie: Natural language is sufficient for inter-agent precision.
